corporateTax.adviserPendingBody: The corporate tax rules (QFZP, interest limitation, transfer pricing, Small Business Relief) apply published thresholds. Ask your tax adviser to review this company's set-up, then record the confirmation here.
corporateTax.amendDefaultReason: Amendment opened from the corporate tax page
corporateTax.amendmentCreated: Amendment created as a new draft; the filed return is unchanged
corporateTax.einvoicingBandAuto: From the latest corporate tax return
corporateTax.exciseHelp: Adds monthly excise returns to the compliance calendar
corporateTax.figureEstimateHint: Estimate from the books: not a reviewed or filed return.
corporateTax.lifecycleHelp: Draft → computed → reviewed by a second person → recorded as filed. Muhasib does not submit returns: upload the export to EmaraTax yourself. Filed returns cannot be edited; amend them instead.
corporateTax.postProvisionOnFiling: Post the corporate tax provision when filing
corporateTax.profileDescription: Free zone status, compliance settings and the related-party register used by the computation and the compliance calendar.
corporateTax.qfzpHelp: 0% on qualifying income while non-qualifying revenue stays within 5% and AED 5 million
corporateTax.relatedPartiesHelp: A transfer pricing disclosure form is required when related-party transactions exceed AED 40 million.
corporateTax.pageSubtitle: UAE Corporate Tax — 9% on taxable income above AED 375,000
corporateTax.workpaperDescription: Enter revenue and expense lines exactly like the Excel schedule used before filing. These rows support the draft return and do not mark anything as submitted.
corporateTax.workpaperDisclaimer: This is a corporate tax support schedule. It creates a draft return only; it does not submit to the FTA and it does not post accounting entries.
corporateTax.calculatorDescription: Calculate corporate tax from your journal entries for a given period
corporateTax.fileDialogHint: Muhasib does not submit to the FTA. Upload the return in EmaraTax first, then enter the reference EmaraTax gave you. A filed return can no longer be edited.
corporateTax.fileDialogProvision: The corporate tax provision will be posted to the ledger on the period end date.
corporateTax.periodLockedProvision: The period end is in a closed (soft-locked) period. Posting the provision there needs an audited reason.
corporateTax.lockOverrideReason: Reason for posting into the closed period
corporateTax.unfileHint: Use this if the return was recorded as filed by mistake. It goes back to reviewed, the filing reference is cleared and any provision posted at filing is reversed. The reason is kept in the audit trail.
